window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(hle): honor the requested executable on relaunch
matched_lines: runtime stores an absolute image path while relaunch_args searched raw CLI arguments for exact text, so a relative launch argument made XLaunchNewGame silently rerun the old title. Normalize the argument the same way runtime does before replacing it. Also split the title's quoted config args into proper arguments instead of split_whitespace. Add a regression covering a relative startup path, a different target and quoted/empty args.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(hle): read manifest fields past inline XML comments
matched_lines: elements() took field text up to the next '<', so a generator comment before the value made TitleId, StoreId or SizeMB empty. Skip comments while gathering the text. Add a regression with comments inside all three fields.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(pe): keep every name for a shared export ordinal
matched_lines: The PE-specific export table stores one name per address-table slot, so when two names alias one ordinal the earlier name is silently dropped from ImageInfo and from victory inspect --exports. Use the generic Object::exports iterator instead, which yields every named export and then ordinal-only entries, and map its target and flags back to our representation. Add a synthetic PE regression with two names for one ordinal plus a separate export.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(pipeline): retry collisions when creating cache staging files
matched_lines: Preserve stale staging files left by interrupted writers and retry a bounded number of atomic create_new attempts. Propagate unrelated I/O errors immediately. Add deterministic CPU regressions. AI-assisted.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: GPU: hold SHADER_HEAPS across descriptor mirror and check query offsets
matched_lines: mirror() previously dropped the SHADER_HEAPS lock inside shader_slot() before using the returned &Heap, allowing a concurrent Heap::drop to free the heap while mirror() accessed it. Also guards copy_simple() against invalid descriptor kinds, rejects placed heaps whose address+size wraps u64, and checks offset+count*bytes in resolve_queries() against overflow (with a regression test).

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: Take the parked lane-mask change (#11) back out for now
fix(hle): return XAsync payloads for nonnegative results
matched_lines: GetResultSize and GetResult only treated S_OK as success, so a provider finishing with S_FALSE and a payload left the caller's buffers untouched and the call registered forever. Any nonnegative HRESULT is a success code; return the size, let the provider write the result, report bytes used, and release the call. Add a regression completing with S_FALSE and an eight-byte payload.

Normalize the argument the same way runtime does before replacing it. Also split the title's quoted config args into proper arguments instead of split_whitespace. Add a regression covering a relative startup path, a different target and quoted/empty args.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(hle): read manifest fields past inline XML comments
matched_lines: elements() took field text up to the next '<', so a generator comment before the value made TitleId, StoreId or SizeMB empty. Skip comments while gathering the text. Add a regression with comments inside all three fields.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(pe): keep every name for a shared export ordinal
matched_lines: The PE-specific export table stores one name per address-table slot, so when two names alias one ordinal the earlier name is silently dropped from ImageInfo and from victory inspect --exports. Use the generic Object::exports iterator instead, which yields every named export and then ordinal-only entries, and map its target and flags back to our representation. Add a synthetic PE regression with two names for one ordinal plus a separate export.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: fix(pipeline): retry collisions when creating cache staging files
matched_lines: Preserve stale staging files left by interrupted writers and retry a bounded number of atomic create_new attempts. Propagate unrelated I/O errors immediately. Add deterministic CPU regressions. AI-assisted.

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: GPU: hold SHADER_HEAPS across descriptor mirror and check query offsets
matched_lines: mirror() previously dropped the SHADER_HEAPS lock inside shader_slot() before using the returned &Heap, allowing a concurrent Heap::drop to free the heap while mirror() accessed it. Also guards copy_simple() against invalid descriptor kinds, rejects placed heaps whose address+size wraps u64, and checks offset+count*bytes in resolve_queries() against overflow (with a regression test).

window_revert_keyword_matches.subject: Take the parked lane-mask change (#11) back out for now
fix(hle): return XAsync payloads for nonnegative results
matched_lines: GetResultSize and GetResult only treated S_OK as success, so a provider finishing with S_FALSE and a payload left the caller's buffers untouched and the call registered forever. Any nonnegative HRESULT is a success code; return the size, let the provider write the result, report bytes used, and release the call. Add a regression completing with S_FALSE and an eight-byte payload.
